recipes.name: Hummus and Veggie Snack Box
steps: Put hummus in a small container; pack vegetables and crackers around it.

recipes.name: Tuna Cucumber Bites
ing: can (5 oz) light tuna in water, drained

recipes.name: Salted Edamame Cup
steps: Boil or microwave edamame 3-4 minutes; drain.
recipes.notes: About 17 g protein per cup of shelled edamame.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Apple Slices
steps: Slice the apple and dip in peanut butter.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese and Pineapple Cup
recipes.notes: About 25 g protein. Good before bed.

recipes.name: Turkey and Cheese Roll-Ups
steps: Spread mustard on turkey; add half a cheese slice; roll up.

recipes.name: Crunchy Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Heat oven to 425F. Pat chickpeas very dry.
Toss with oil, paprika and salt; roast on a sheet pan 25-30 minutes, shaking once.
recipes.notes: Store uncovered-ish in a jar; they soften after a day.

recipes.name: Hard-Boiled Egg Snack Box
steps: Peel eggs; pack with fruit and nuts.
recipes.notes: Boiled eggs keep 7 days in the fridge.

recipes.name: Protein Trail Mix
steps: Mix in a jar. Portion 1/4 cup per serving.

recipes.name: Chocolate Protein Pudding
steps: Stir everything until smooth; chill 10 minutes.
recipes.notes: Add a splash of milk if too thick.

recipes.name: Banana Oat Bites
steps: Mix everything; scoop 12 balls onto a lined sheet.
recipes.notes: Keeps 4 days; freezes 3 months. Makes 12 bites; count 2 per serving for 6 servings.

recipes.name: Salsa Bean Cups
steps: Layer beans, salsa, yogurt and cheese in 2 cups; microwave 60 seconds if you like it warm.
